about: 100 foidslop meal entries inspired by the girl dinner trend. Each meal is a low effort, high satisfaction solo plate. Use photo_search to find reference images for your own photography.

meals.name: The OG Girl Dinner
meals.description: Bread, butter, sharp cheese, grapes, and pickles. The medieval peasant plate that started it all.

ingredients.name: sharp cheddar or aged gouda, sliced

steps.name: Arrange
steps.text: Lay the 2 slices of sourdough on a wooden board. Slather them thickly with the 2 tablespoons of room temperature butter so it melts into the bread. Slice the 60g of sharp cheddar or aged gouda and lay it alongside the bread. Add a small bunch of red grapes and a few cornichons or dill pickles to fill the gaps. There are no rules here, just arrange by color and texture and enjoy the contrast of creamy butter, sharp cheese, and briny pickles.

meals.notes: The original Olivia Maher TikTok that started the whole trend. Use the best butter you can find because it matters here.
meals.photo_search: rustic wooden board with sliced sourdough, thick slabs of butter, sharp cheddar, red grapes, and dill pickles

meals.name: Whipped Feta with Hot Honey and Walnuts
meals.description: Creamy, salty, sweet, and crunchy. Four textures in one bowl with zero cooking required.

steps.name: Whip
steps.text: Add the 150g of crumbled feta and 2 tablespoons of cream cheese to a food processor. Blend for a full 2 minutes, scraping down the sides halfway, until the mixture is completely smooth and fluffy. If it feels too stiff, add a tiny splash of water to loosen it.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Spoon the whipped feta into a shallow bowl and use the back of a spoon to create a deep swirl in the center. Drizzle 1 tablespoon of olive oil and 1 tablespoon of hot honey directly into the swirl. Scatter a handful of roughly chopped toasted walnuts over the top so they fall into the crevices. Serve immediately with crackers or crusty bread.

meals.notes: No food processor? Mash with a fork and beat vigorously. Less smooth but still excellent.
meals.photo_search: ceramic bowl of whipped feta drizzled with hot honey and scattered with toasted walnuts, served with crackers

meals.name: Chilli Crisp Noodles with Soft-Boiled Egg
meals.description: Six minute noodles that taste like you ordered them from a really good spot.

ingredients.name: dried noodles (ramen, soba, or rice noodles)

steps.name: Soft boil egg
steps.text: Bring a small pot of water to a rolling boil. Gently lower the 1 large egg into the water and set a timer for exactly 6.5 minutes for a perfectly jammy yolk. Transfer the egg immediately to an ice water bath to stop the cooking process, then peel it under cold running water.

steps.name: Cook noodles
steps.text: Boil the 1 portion of dried noodles in the same pot according to the package until chewy. While they cook, whisk the 1.5 tbsp chilli crisp, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil, and 1 tsp rice vinegar together in the bottom of your serving bowl.

steps.name: Combine
steps.text: Drain the noodles and add them directly to the sauce bowl. Toss vigorously with tongs until every strand is coated in the spicy oil. Halve the soft boiled egg and place it on top of the noodles, letting the yolk run slightly. Scatter the 2 thinly sliced spring onions over the top and eat right away while piping hot.

meals.notes: Fly By Jing chilli crisp is worth the upgrade over Lao Gan Ma. Add peanut butter for a satay vibe.
meals.photo_search: bowl of noodles in red chilli crisp oil topped with a halved soft boiled egg and spring onions

meals.name: Baked Feta Pasta
meals.description: The TikTok pasta that broke the internet. Roasted tomatoes, melted feta, done.

steps.name: Roast
steps.text: Preheat your oven to 400F/200C. Place the 200g of cherry tomatoes and 3 cloves of smashed, unpeeled garlic in the center of a baking dish. Nestle the 100g block of feta right in the middle. Pour 3 tablespoons of olive oil over the tomatoes and feta, and sprinkle with chilli flakes. Roast for 35 minutes until the tomatoes burst and release their juices, and the feta turns golden on top.

steps.name: Cook pasta
steps.text: While the feta roasts, boil the 100g of pasta in heavily salted water until al dente. Before draining, scoop out a full cup of the starchy pasta water and set it aside.

steps.name: Combine
steps.text: Remove the baking dish from the oven. Squeeze the soft roasted garlic out of its skins and mash it into the melted feta with a fork. Add the drained pasta and a splash of the reserved pasta water. Stir everything together vigorously until the cheese and tomato juices emulsify into a glossy, silky sauce. Top with a handful of torn fresh basil.

meals.notes: Use the best quality block feta you can find. Pre crumbled will not melt the same way.
meals.photo_search: baked pasta with melted feta and burst cherry tomatoes in a ceramic casserole dish

meals.name: Cottage Cheese and Everything Bagel Plate
meals.description: High protein, zero effort. Cottage cheese elevated by one seasoning that does all the work.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Scoop the 1 cup of full fat cottage cheese into a wide, shallow bowl. Use the back of a spoon to create a deep divot in the center of the cheese. Pour a generous drizzle of good olive oil directly into the divot. Shower the top with 1 teaspoon of everything bagel seasoning so the seeds fall into the oil and cheese. Arrange a handful of halved cherry tomatoes around the edges and serve with crackers or cucumber slices for scooping.

meals.notes: Add chilli crisp instead of olive oil for a spicy upgrade. Trader Joe's Everything But The Bagel seasoning is the move.
meals.photo_search: bowl of cottage cheese topped with everything bagel seasoning, olive oil, cherry tomatoes, and crackers

meals.name: Tinned Sardines on Buttered Toast
meals.description: Briny, rich, and done in two minutes. The girl dinner for people with great taste.

ingredients.name: flaky sea salt, black pepper, hot sauce

steps.name: Toast and butter
steps.text: Toast the 2 slices of sourdough until they are deeply golden and crisp. While the bread is still piping hot, spread 1 tablespoon of salted butter generously over the surface so it melts deep into the crumbs.

steps.name: Top
steps.text: Open the tin of sardines and lay them in a single layer over the buttered toast. Squeeze the juice of half a lemon directly over the fish. Add flaky sea salt, black pepper, and your favorite hot sauce. If you are using dijon mustard and sliced cornichons, smear the mustard on the bread before adding the sardines, and place the cornichons on top for a briny crunch.

meals.notes: Brand matters enormously. A good tin of sardines in olive oil is a completely different thing from the cheap supermarket version.
meals.photo_search: sourdough toast heavily buttered and topped with sardines, lemon wedges, and black pepper

meals.name: Burrata with Peach and Prosciutto
meals.description: Sweet peach, salty prosciutto, creamy burrata. Summer on a plate with no cooking required.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Place the 1 ball of fresh burrata in the center of a beautiful plate. Slice the 1 ripe peach and arrange the slices around the burrata. Drape the 3 slices of prosciutto di Parma over the peaches. Tuck a handful of fresh basil leaves into the gaps. Just before eating, tear the burrata open so the creamy center spills out. Finish with a drizzle of good olive oil, a swirl of balsamic glaze, and a pinch of flaky salt.

meals.notes: Tear the burrata open at the table so the cream spills out. Only works with ripe, in season peaches.
meals.photo_search: plate with burrata, sliced peaches, prosciutto, balsamic glaze, and fresh basil

meals.name: Smoked Salmon Plate with Cream Cheese and Capers
meals.description: Deli style but make it dinner. Everything a bagel would be without the bagel.

steps.name: Arrange
steps.text: Lay the 80g of smoked salmon slices on one side of a plate. Put the 3 tablespoons of cream cheese in a small bowl on the opposite side. Scatter 1 tablespoon of capers and the very thinly sliced red onion over the salmon. Add a handful of rye crackers, a few sprigs of fresh dill, and a lemon wedge for squeezing. Build little cracker sandwiches as you eat.

meals.notes: Let red onion soak in a splash of lemon juice for 10 minutes to mellow the bite.
meals.photo_search: plate of smoked salmon, cream cheese bowl, capers, red onion, rye crackers, and dill

meals.name: Avocado Toast with Everything Bagel and Chilli Flakes
meals.description: Yes it is basic. Yes it is still perfect. The seasoning and chilli flakes make it.

steps.name: Toast
steps.text: Toast the 2 slices of thick sourdough until deeply golden and crisp.

steps.name: Mash and top
steps.text: Halve the 1 large ripe avocado, remove the pit, and scoop the flesh directly onto the hot toast. Use a fork to mash it roughly right on the bread. Immediately squeeze fresh lemon or lime juice over the avocado to prevent browning. Shower with 1 teaspoon of everything bagel seasoning, a pinch of chilli flakes, and a sprinkle of flaky salt.

meals.notes: Top with a fried or poached egg for protein. Pomegranate seeds add great texture.
meals.photo_search: sourdough toast topped with mashed avocado, everything bagel seasoning, and chilli flakes

meals.name: Hummus Plate with Warm Pita and Toppings
meals.description: A good hummus plate hits different when the pita is warm and the toppings are thoughtful.

steps.name: Warm pita
steps.text: Place the 1 pita bread directly over a gas flame or in a dry pan for about 30 seconds per side until it puffs up and gets charred in spots.

steps.name: Build the plate
steps.text: Spoon the 1/2 cup of hummus into a bowl and use the back of a spoon to create a deep swirl in the center. Drizzle generously with olive oil and dust with 1/4 teaspoon of smoked paprika. Arrange the halved cherry tomatoes, sliced cucumber, and olives around the hummus. Tear the warm pita into wedges and serve alongside for dipping.

meals.notes: Sabra is fine but Ithaca or Oren's Hummus will genuinely change the dish.
meals.photo_search: bowl of hummus swirled with olive oil and paprika, served with warm pita, cucumbers, and olives

meals.name: Lazy Mac and Cheese
meals.description: Kraft in a pot, made correctly. Extra butter, black pepper, and no apologies.

ingredients.name: Kraft mac and cheese or Annie's
salted butter (more than the box says)
hot sauce, extra shredded cheese, breadcrumbs

steps.name: Cook
steps.text: Boil the pasta from the 1 box of mac and cheese according to the package instructions. Drain the pasta, but leave about a tablespoon of the starchy cooking water in the pot to help the sauce bind.

steps.name: Make it better
steps.text: Return the pot to very low heat. Add 2 tablespoons of salted butter (more than the box recommends), the cheese powder, and just a small splash of whole milk. Stir vigorously until the butter and powder melt into a glossy sauce that coats every noodle. Finish with a very generous grinding of black pepper to cut the richness.

meals.notes: The secret is extra butter and less milk than the box says. Top with butter toasted breadcrumbs if you want to feel fancy.
meals.photo_search: bowl of creamy macaroni and cheese topped with freshly ground black pepper

meals.name: Grilled Cheese Dipped in Tomato Soup
meals.description: The ultimate comfort duo. Golden buttery bread, melted cheese, silky soup for dunking.

ingredients.name: American cheese or sharp cheddar, sliced
splash of cream stirred into soup

steps.name: Heat soup
steps.text: Pour the 1 can of tomato soup into a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir in a splash of cream if you want it extra rich. Keep it warm while you make the sandwich.

steps.name: Grill the cheese
steps.text: Spread the 2 tablespoons of softened butter evenly on the outside of both slices of bread. Place the 60g of sliced cheese between the unbuttered sides. Heat a pan over medium low heat. Cook the sandwich for 3 to 4 minutes per side, pressing down gently with a spatula, until both sides are deeply golden and the cheese is completely melted.

steps.name: Dip
steps.text: Cut the grilled cheese in half diagonally. Ladle the hot soup into a mug or bowl. Dunk the sandwich directly into the soup and eat immediately.

meals.notes: Medium low heat is the key to grilled cheese. Patience gives you an even golden crust without burnt bread.
meals.photo_search: grilled cheese sandwich cut in half, served with a bowl of tomato soup for dipping

meals.name: Charcuterie Snack Plate for One
meals.description: All the hits of a charcuterie board scaled down to a solo dinner plate.

ingredients.name: aged cheddar or manchego, sliced or cubed

steps.name: Arrange
steps.text: Fan the 30g of salami or prosciutto out on one side of a plate. Place the 30g of sliced or cubed aged cheddar on the opposite side. Fill the middle with a handful of crackers. Add a small bowl with 1 tablespoon of mustard, and scatter handfuls of grapes, olives, and cornichons in the gaps so everything is easy to reach. Leave some white space on the plate so it does not look crowded.

meals.notes: Odd numbers look better. Three types of element minimum. Do not crowd. Leave some white space on the plate.
meals.photo_search: small wooden board with folded salami, sliced cheddar, crackers, grapes, olives, and mustard

meals.name: Butter Noodles with Parmesan and Black Pepper
meals.description: Cacio e pepe's lazy cousin. Butter, parmesan, pepper, done in 10 minutes.

steps.name: Cook pasta
steps.text: Boil the 100g of spaghetti in heavily salted water until al dente. Before draining, scoop out a large mug of the starchy pasta water and set it aside.

steps.name: Butter and toss
steps.text: Return the drained pasta to the pot off the heat. Add the 3 tablespoons of salted butter and a splash of the reserved pasta water. Toss vigorously with tongs until the butter emulsifies with the starch and coats every strand. Add the 40g of finely grated parmesan and more pasta water, tossing again until you have a silky sauce.

steps.name: Season
steps.text: Finish with 1 teaspoon of coarsely ground black pepper and top with extra parmesan.

meals.notes: The pasta water is the secret. The starch helps the butter create a silky sauce that clings to the noodles.
meals.photo_search: bowl of spaghetti tossed in butter and parmesan with coarsely ground black pepper

meals.name: Scrambled Eggs with Cream Cheese and Chives
meals.description: Low and slow eggs with cream cheese folded in. The softest, richest scramble.

steps.name: Whisk
steps.text: Crack the 3 large eggs into a bowl and beat them thoroughly with a pinch of salt until completely uniform.

steps.name: Low and slow
steps.text: Melt 1 tablespoon of salted butter in a small non stick pan over the absolute lowest heat. Pour in the eggs and stir constantly with a rubber spatula, scraping the bottom and sides to form soft curds. This should take 5 to 7 minutes. Do not rush it.

steps.name: Finish
steps.text: When the eggs are just barely set and still look slightly wet, remove the pan from the heat. Fold in 1 tablespoon of cream cheese so it melts from the residual heat. Top with a small bunch of snipped fresh chives and black pepper.

meals.notes: Keep it low and slow and keep it moving. Taking it off the heat early is not optional.
meals.photo_search: plate of soft scrambled eggs with cream cheese and chives, served with toast

meals.name: Brie with Jam and Apple on a Board
meals.description: Ripe brie, sharp jam, crisp apple slices. The girl dinner that feels like a French picnic.

ingredients.name: crisp apple (Granny Smith or Honeycrisp), thinly sliced

steps.name: Arrange
steps.text: Place the 1 wedge of ripe brie on a small board. Spoon 1 tablespoon of fig or raspberry jam right alongside it. Thinly slice half of a crisp apple and fan the slices out on the board. Add a handful of water biscuits. Drizzle honey over the brie and add walnuts if you want extra crunch.

meals.notes: Let the brie sit at room temperature for 30 minutes first. Cold brie is a tragedy.
meals.photo_search: small wooden board with a wedge of brie, fig jam, apple slices, and water crackers

meals.name: Greek Salad with Chickpeas
meals.description: The most refreshing no cook dinner. Salty, crunchy, and genuinely satisfying.

steps.name: Toss
steps.text: Combine the half can of drained chickpeas, chunked cucumber, halved cherry tomatoes, and thinly sliced red onion in a bowl. Drizzle with 2 tablespoons of olive oil, 1 tablespoon of red wine vinegar, and half a teaspoon of dried oregano. Season with salt and pepper and let it sit for 10 minutes so the tomatoes release their juices. Top with 50g of crumbled feta just before eating.

meals.notes: Let it sit for 10 minutes after dressing. The tomatoes release juice that becomes the best extra dressing.
meals.photo_search: bowl of chunky cucumber, cherry tomatoes, chickpeas, olives, and crumbled feta

meals.name: Loaded Baked Potato
meals.description: A whole meal in a potato skin. Sour cream, cheese, chives, the works.

steps.name: Bake
steps.text: Preheat your oven to 425F/220C. Rub the 1 large russet potato with 1 tablespoon of olive oil and a generous pinch of salt. Pierce it several times with a fork. Bake directly on the oven rack for 45 to 50 minutes until the skin is crispy and the inside is soft when squeezed.

steps.name: Load
steps.text: Split the potato open with a knife and push the ends together to puff up the fluffy inside. Add a pat of butter, then pile on 3 tablespoons of sour cream, 40g of shredded cheddar, a small bunch of chopped chives, and black pepper.

meals.notes: The key is rubbing with oil and salt and not wrapping in foil. Foil steams rather than bakes and ruins the skin.
meals.photo_search: baked potato split open and loaded with sour cream, cheddar, chives, and butter

meals.name: Fruit and Yogurt Bowl with Honey and Granola
meals.description: Breakfast as dinner is always valid. Greek yogurt, fruit, honey, crunch.

ingredients.name: banana slices, nut butter, chia seeds

steps.name: Layer
steps.text: Spoon the 1 cup of thick full fat Greek yogurt into a bowl. Top with a handful of mixed berries and a quarter cup of granola for crunch. Drizzle 1 tablespoon of honey generously over the top. Add banana slices or a spoonful of nut butter if you want to make it more filling.

meals.notes: Full fat Greek yogurt is non negotiable. It is thick enough to hold toppings and rich enough to feel like a proper meal.
meals.photo_search: bowl of thick Greek yogurt topped with granola, mixed berries, and a drizzle of honey

meals.name: Soft Pretzel with Beer Cheese Dip
meals.description: Warm soft pretzels and a quick melted cheese sauce. Salty, satisfying, no real effort.

ingredients.name: soft pretzels, frozen or store bought, warmed

steps.name: Make cheese sauce
steps.text: Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a small saucepan over medium heat. Whisk in 1 teaspoon of flour to make a roux and cook for 1 minute. Slowly whisk in a quarter cup of beer or milk until smooth. Add 60g of shredded sharp cheddar and 1 teaspoon of dijon mustard, stirring continuously until the cheese is completely melted and glossy.

steps.name: Serve
steps.text: Warm the 2 to 3 soft pretzels according to the package instructions. Dip them straight into the pot of warm cheese sauce.

meals.notes: A splash of hot sauce in the cheese sauce makes it noticeably better.
meals.photo_search: basket of warm soft pretzels served with a bowl of melted beer cheese dip

meals.name: Pickles and Cheese Board
meals.description: For when the jar of pickles IS the meal. Paired with aged cheese and crackers.

steps.name: Plate it
steps.text: Arrange a few dill pickles, 60g of sharp aged cheddar, and a handful of crackers on a plate. If using salami and mustard, add them to the mix. The joy is in the simplicity, so just lay it out and eat.

meals.notes: Claussen dill pickles, aged white cheddar, Triscuits. That is the holy trinity.
meals.photo_search: plate of dill pickles, sharp cheddar slices, and crackers

meals.name: Instant Ramen Upgraded
meals.description: Start with a 50 cent packet, finish with something that actually tastes good.

ingredients.name: frozen corn, spring onion, sesame seeds, chilli crisp

steps.name: Cook
steps.text: Cook the 1 packet of instant ramen according to the package instructions, but use slightly less water than recommended to keep the broth concentrated and flavorful.

steps.name: Upgrade
steps.text: In the last 2 minutes of cooking, crack the 1 large egg directly into the bubbling broth. Remove from heat and stir in 1 tablespoon of butter, 1 teaspoon of sesame oil, and 1 teaspoon of soy sauce. Top with spring onions, sesame seeds, and chilli crisp.

meals.notes: Butter and sesame oil are the key upgrades. The egg is non negotiable.
meals.photo_search: bowl of ramen with an egg, butter, spring onions, sesame seeds, and chilli crisp

meals.name: Caprese with Good Olive Oil
meals.description: Three ingredients, zero cooking. Entirely dependent on quality. Get good tomatoes.

ingredients.name: ripe heirloom or vine tomatoes, sliced
flaky sea salt and black pepper

steps.name: Slice and alternate
steps.text: Slice the 2 large ripe tomatoes and 125g of fresh mozzarella into thick rounds. Alternate them on a plate, tucking fresh basil leaves between them.

steps.name: Dress
steps.text: Drizzle generously with 2 tablespoons of excellent olive oil. Season aggressively with flaky sea salt and black pepper. Add a balsamic reduction if you like.

meals.notes: This is either transcendent or boring depending entirely on ingredient quality. Buy the best tomatoes you can find.
meals.photo_search: plate of alternating heirloom tomato and mozzarella slices with fresh basil and olive oil

meals.name: Stovetop Popcorn Dinner
meals.description: A bit unhinged but completely valid. Stovetop popcorn with real butter and fancy seasoning.

ingredients.name: nutritional yeast, parmesan, tajin, everything bagel, or chilli lime seasoning

steps.name: Pop
steps.text: Heat 2 tablespoons of neutral oil in a large pot over medium high. Add 3 test kernels and cover. When they pop, add the rest of the kernels, cover, and shake the pot every 30 seconds until popping slows.

steps.name: Season
steps.text: Transfer to a bowl, immediately toss with 2 tablespoons of melted butter, flaky salt, and your seasoning of choice so it sticks to the hot kernels.

meals.notes: Stovetop popcorn is infinitely superior to microwave. Nutritional yeast plus salt is the underrated combination.
meals.photo_search: large bowl of stovetop popcorn dusted with seasoning and melted butter

meals.name: Ricotta Toast with Honey and Pistachios
meals.description: Creamy, crunchy, sweet. The toast that makes breakfast for dinner feel indulgent.

ingredients.name: thick sourdough or country bread, toasted

steps.name: Toast
steps.text: Toast the 2 slices of thick sourdough until deeply golden.

steps.name: Top
steps.text: Spread a generous layer of 4 tablespoons of whole milk ricotta on each slice. Drizzle with 1 tablespoon of good honey, scatter 2 tablespoons of roughly chopped pistachios, and finish with a pinch of flaky salt. Add lemon zest or fresh thyme for extra flavor.

meals.notes: The ricotta needs to be full fat and ideally fresh. Whip it with a fork first for a fluffier texture.
meals.photo_search: sourdough toast spread with ricotta, drizzled with honey, and topped with pistachios

meals.name: Brie and Raspberry Quesadilla
meals.description: Sweet savory quesadilla that sounds wrong but is absolutely right.

steps.name: Build
steps.text: Spread 1 tablespoon of raspberry jam on one half of the 1 large flour tortilla. Lay 60g of thinly sliced brie on top and fold it over.

steps.name: Cook
steps.text: Melt 1 teaspoon of butter in a pan over medium heat. Cook the quesadilla for 2 to 3 minutes per side, pressing down with a spatula, until golden and the brie is fully melted. Cut and eat immediately.

meals.notes: Add a thin layer of dijon on the jam side for a more grown up sweet savory balance.
meals.photo_search: golden crispy quesadilla cut in half, showing melted brie and raspberry jam inside

meals.name: Mezze Plate
meals.description: Hummus, tabbouleh, olives, pita. The Middle Eastern answer to the girl dinner snack plate.

steps.name: Arrange
steps.text: Group the 1/3 cup of hummus, 1/3 cup of tabbouleh, mixed olives, and 50g of cubed feta in separate sections of a large plate or small board. Swirl a spoon through the hummus and drizzle it with olive oil. Serve the warmed, torn pita alongside for building bites.

meals.notes: Store bought shortcuts are completely valid. Good supermarket hummus and tabbouleh are excellent.
meals.photo_search: mezze plate with hummus, tabbouleh, olives, feta, sliced cucumber, and torn pita

meals.name: Fried Egg on Toast with Hot Sauce
meals.description: A perfectly fried egg with crispy lacy edges on buttered toast. Never gets old.

ingredients.name: flaky salt, black pepper, hot sauce (Crystal or Cholula)

steps.name: Fry the eggs
steps.text: Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a small pan over medium high heat until foamy and just starting to brown. Crack the 2 large eggs into the pan and season immediately. Let the whites set and the edges go lacy and crispy while the yolk stays runny, about 2 to 3 minutes.

steps.name: Serve
steps.text: Slide the eggs onto buttered sourdough and add hot sauce. Eat immediately.

meals.notes: High heat and enough fat is what creates the crispy, lacy white edges. Do not be shy.
meals.photo_search: sourdough toast topped with fried eggs with crispy edges, drizzled with hot sauce

meals.name: Antipasto Plate
meals.description: Italian store bought excellence arranged beautifully. Artichoke hearts, salami, olives, marinated things.

ingredients.name: roasted red peppers from a jar

steps.name: Arrange
steps.text: Lay out the 30g of salami, marinated artichoke hearts, olives, and mozzarella balls on a plate. Add the roasted red peppers and drizzle everything lightly with olive oil. Tear off pieces of focaccia or ciabatta to eat alongside.

meals.notes: Castelvetrano olives are buttery and mild. Perfect for those who do not love super briny olives.
meals.photo_search: plate of salami, marinated artichoke hearts, olives, mozzarella balls, and roasted peppers

meals.name: Brown Butter Gnocchi with Sage
meals.description: Pillowy store bought gnocchi in nutty brown butter with crispy sage. Ready in 10 minutes.

steps.name: Cook gnocchi
steps.text: Boil the 250g of gnocchi in salted water until they float, about 2 to 3 minutes, then drain.

steps.name: Brown butter
steps.text: In the same pan, melt the 3 tablespoons of salted butter over medium heat. Add the 6 to 8 fresh sage leaves. Cook until the butter turns golden brown and smells nutty, about 3 to 4 minutes.

steps.name: Toss
steps.text: Toss the gnocchi in the brown butter to coat. Top with 30g of grated parmesan and black pepper.

meals.notes: Watch the butter carefully once it starts foaming. It goes from golden to burnt very fast.
meals.photo_search: bowl of potato gnocchi in brown butter sauce with crispy sage leaves and parmesan

meals.name: Classic Cheese Quesadilla
meals.description: The comfort food that requires no recipe. Just cheese, a tortilla, and heat.

ingredients.name: Oaxacan cheese or Monterey Jack, shredded

steps.name: Fill
steps.text: Scatter the 80g of shredded cheese over one half of the 1 large flour tortilla and fold it over.

steps.name: Cook
steps.text: Heat a dry pan over medium heat. Cook the quesadilla for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden and the cheese is fully melted. Slice into wedges and serve with 1 tablespoon of salsa and 2 tablespoons of sour cream.

meals.notes: The most underrated move is a light smear of refried beans before the cheese.
meals.photo_search: golden crispy cheese quesadilla served with salsa and sour cream

meals.name: Cucumber Cream Cheese Bites
meals.description: Refreshing, crunchy little bites. A snack that feels like an appetizer.

ingredients.name: English cucumber, sliced into thick rounds
cream cheese or whipped cream cheese
smoked salmon, capers, or sliced radish on top

steps.name: Top
steps.text: Slice the 1 large English cucumber into thick rounds. Spread a small dollop of cream cheese on each round. Dust with 1 teaspoon of everything bagel seasoning. Top with smoked salmon, capers, or sliced radish if you want to make them fancy.

meals.notes: Make these when you want something crunchy and satisfying with zero effort.
meals.photo_search: cucumber rounds topped with cream cheese, everything bagel seasoning, and smoked salmon

meals.name: Crispy Spiced Chickpea and Feta Bowl
meals.description: Crispy spiced chickpeas over lemony yogurt with feta and herbs. Deeply satisfying.

steps.name: Roast chickpeas
steps.text: Toss the 1 can of dried chickpeas with 1.5 tablespoons of olive oil, 1 teaspoon of smoked paprika, 1/2 teaspoon of cumin, and salt. Spread on a baking sheet and roast at 425F/220C for 20 to 25 minutes until deeply golden and crispy.

steps.name: Build bowl
steps.text: Spoon 1/2 cup of Greek yogurt into a bowl, season with lemon juice and salt. Top with the roasted chickpeas, 50g of crumbled feta, and fresh herbs.

meals.notes: Drying the chickpeas thoroughly before roasting is what makes them crispy rather than chewy.
meals.photo_search: bowl of lemony yogurt topped with crispy spiced chickpeas, feta, and fresh herbs

meals.name: Peanut Butter Sesame Noodles
meals.description: Sesame peanut sauce over noodles. The most satisfying thing you can make in 15 minutes.

ingredients.name: spring onion, sesame seeds, cucumber ribbons

steps.name: Make sauce
steps.text: Whisk the 2 tablespoons of peanut butter, 1 tablespoon of soy sauce, 1 tablespoon of rice vinegar, 1 teaspoon of sesame oil, 1 teaspoon of honey, and sriracha. Thin with warm water until it is pourable.

steps.name: Cook and toss
steps.text: Boil the 100g of noodles per package, drain, and toss immediately with the sauce. Top with spring onions, sesame seeds, and cucumber ribbons.

meals.notes: Natural peanut butter works best. The sauce keeps refrigerated for a week. Make double.
meals.photo_search: bowl of soba noodles in peanut sesame sauce, topped with spring onions and cucumber ribbons

meals.name: Guacamole and Tortilla Chips
meals.description: Homemade guacamole in five minutes. Because you deserve better than the tub.

steps.name: Mash
steps.text: Halve the 1 large ripe avocado, remove the pit, and scoop the flesh into a bowl. Mash with a fork to your preferred texture.

steps.name: Season
steps.text: Add the juice of 1/4 lime, 2 tablespoons of finely diced red onion, 1 tablespoon of minced jalapeño, cilantro, and a generous pinch of salt. Taste and adjust, then serve immediately with tortilla chips.

meals.notes: The lime juice both flavors the guac and prevents browning. Add it before anything else.
meals.photo_search: rustic bowl of chunky guacamole served with tortilla chips

meals.name: Sleepy Girl Mocktail
meals.description: The viral tart cherry and magnesium drink that took over TikTok. For winding down.

ingredients.name: sparkling water or prebiotic soda (Olipop, Poppi)

steps.name: Mix
steps.text: Fill a glass with ice. Pour in 1/2 cup of tart cherry juice and stir in 1 scoop of magnesium powder until completely dissolved. Top with sparkling water or prebiotic soda. Garnish with a lime wedge.

meals.notes: Best drunk 30 to 60 minutes before bed. The combo of tart cherry and magnesium is the whole point.
meals.photo_search: glass of iced tart cherry juice mixed with sparkling water, garnished with lime

meals.name: Cold Sesame Noodles
meals.description: Room temperature noodles in a nutty, gingery sauce. Better cold than hot.

ingredients.name: shredded cucumber, sesame seeds, spring onion, chilli oil

steps.name: Cook and cool
steps.text: Boil the 100g of noodles per package, then rinse under cold water until completely cool. Drain well.

steps.name: Sauce and toss
steps.text: Whisk the 2 tablespoons of tahini, 1 tablespoon of soy, 1 tablespoon of rice vinegar, 1 teaspoon of grated ginger, and 1 teaspoon of sesame oil. Thin with water until silky. Toss the cold noodles with the sauce. Top with shredded cucumber, spring onions, sesame seeds, and a swirl of chilli oil.

meals.notes: Make extra sauce. It also works as a dressing for any vegetable.
meals.photo_search: bowl of cold noodles in dark sesame sauce, topped with cucumber, spring onions, and chilli oil

meals.name: Prosciutto and Melon
meals.description: The Italian classic that needs no recipe. Sweet cantaloupe and salty prosciutto.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Lay the 1/4 sliced ripe cantaloupe on a plate. Drape the 3 to 4 slices of prosciutto over each slice. Drizzle with olive oil, add black pepper and flaky salt. Add fresh mint or arugula if using.

meals.notes: Only works with truly ripe, fragrant melon. If the melon is not sweet, this dish is pointless.
meals.photo_search: plate of cantaloupe melon slices wrapped in prosciutto, garnished with black pepper

meals.name: Spinach Artichoke Dip with Pita Chips
meals.description: Warm, cheesy, bubbly dip made in 20 minutes. The shareable girl dinner.

ingredients.name: frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
marinated artichoke hearts, drained and chopped

steps.name: Mix
steps.text: Combine the 1/2 cup of thawed and squeezed spinach, 1/2 cup of chopped artichoke hearts, 100g of cream cheese, 3 tablespoons of sour cream, 40g of grated parmesan, and 1 clove of minced garlic in an oven safe dish. Stir to combine.

steps.name: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 375F/190C for 20 minutes until bubbly and golden. Broil for 2 minutes for extra color.

steps.name: Dip
steps.text: Serve hot with pita chips.

meals.notes: Squeezing every drop of water from the spinach is essential. Otherwise the dip gets watery.
meals.photo_search: bubbling golden spinach and artichoke dip served with pita chips

meals.name: Lox Plate on Cucumber
meals.description: Low carb smoked salmon moment. All the lox flavors, no bagel required.

ingredients.name: English cucumber, sliced into thick rounds

steps.name: Build bites
steps.text: Slice the 1 large English cucumber into thick rounds. Spread 3 tablespoons of cream cheese on each round. Top with a small piece of the 80g of lox, 1 tablespoon of capers, a paper thin slice of red onion, and a sprig of dill.

meals.notes: These also work beautifully on endive leaves for a more elegant presentation.
meals.photo_search: cucumber rounds topped with cream cheese, smoked salmon, capers, red onion, and dill

meals.name: Adult Lunchable Plate
meals.description: Exactly what you think. Crackers, deli meat, cheese, grapes, a little candy if you want.

ingredients.name: baby carrots, apple slices, a few M&Ms

steps.name: Separate and plate
steps.text: Keep everything in distinct piles on a plate. Put the handful of crackers on one side, 3 to 4 slices of deli turkey on another, and 40g of cubed cheddar in the middle. Add grapes, baby carrots, or apple slices in the gaps. No mixing required.

meals.notes: The joy is in the separateness. You eat each thing on its own or build your own stack.
meals.photo_search: plate with distinct piles of crackers, deli turkey, cheddar cheese, and red grapes

meals.name: Garlic Parmesan Toast
meals.description: The simplest, most satisfying thing. Crispy garlic toast with melted parmesan.

steps.name: Make garlic butter
steps.text: Mix the 2 tablespoons of softened butter, 2 cloves of minced garlic, and 3 tablespoons of grated parmesan until combined.

steps.name: Toast
steps.text: Spread the mixture thickly on 2 slices of crusty bread. Broil for 3 to 4 minutes until the edges are golden and the parmesan is crispy. Add fresh parsley and chilli flakes.

meals.notes: Broiling rather than baking gives you the best crispy outside, soft inside texture.
meals.photo_search: toasted crusty bread topped with melted garlic butter and crispy parmesan

meals.name: Cherry Tomato and Mozzarella Pasta
meals.description: Fresh blistered tomato sauce with torn mozzarella that melts into hot pasta. Summer simplicity.

steps.name: Blister tomatoes
steps.text: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over high heat. Add the 200g of cherry tomatoes and let them blister and burst, about 5 minutes. Add 2 cloves of sliced garlic and chilli flakes, cooking 1 minute.

steps.name: Cook pasta
steps.text: Boil the 100g of pasta in well salted water until al dente, saving a splash of pasta water.

steps.name: Combine
steps.text: Toss the pasta with the tomatoes and a splash of pasta water. Remove from heat. Add 80g of torn mozzarella and basil. The residual heat melts the cheese.

meals.notes: Tearing the mozzarella rather than slicing gives you irregular melty pockets throughout the pasta.
meals.photo_search: bowl of rigatoni pasta with blistered cherry tomatoes, torn mozzarella, and fresh basil

meals.name: Edamame with Garlic Butter and Chilli
meals.description: Steamed edamame tossed in garlic butter with chilli. Simple, high protein snack dinner.

steps.name: Cook edamame
steps.text: Microwave or boil the 1 cup of edamame pods until hot, then drain.

steps.name: Toss
steps.text: Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a pan, add 1 clove of minced garlic and a pinch of chilli flakes for 30 seconds. Toss the edamame in the garlic butter and season with flaky sea salt.

meals.notes: Eat by popping the beans directly into your mouth from the pod. The tactile experience is part of it.
meals.photo_search: bowl of edamame pods tossed in garlic butter, chilli flakes, and flaky sea salt

meals.name: Elevated Canned Tomato Soup
meals.description: Good canned tomato bisque made significantly better with cream, butter, and basil oil.

ingredients.name: quality tomato soup or bisque (Rao's or Amy's)
basil oil or good olive oil

steps.name: Heat and enrich
steps.text: Warm the 1 can of tomato soup in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir in 2 tablespoons of heavy cream and 1 tablespoon of butter until completely melted and incorporated.

steps.name: Serve
steps.text: Pour into a mug or bowl, drizzle with basil oil, and add crackers or croutons with flaky salt.

meals.notes: The cream and butter addition sounds minor but genuinely transforms any canned soup.
meals.photo_search: mug of creamy tomato soup topped with croutons and a drizzle of olive oil

meals.name: Tuna Salad on Crackers
meals.description: A proper tuna salad. Mayo, celery, dijon, capers. Scooped onto crackers.

ingredients.name: quality tuna in olive oil (Wild Planet or Ortiz)

steps.name: Mix
steps.text: Drain the 1 can of tuna and combine with 2 tablespoons of mayo, 1 finely diced celery stalk, 1 teaspoon of dijon, 1 tablespoon of chopped capers, and lemon juice. Season with black pepper and mix well. Taste and adjust.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Serve alongside a pile of crackers for scooping.

meals.notes: Quality tuna makes a huge difference. Ortiz in olive oil is in a completely different league from generic supermarket tuna.
meals.photo_search: bowl of tuna salad with celery and capers, served alongside a pile of crackers

meals.name: Goat Cheese Toast with Honey and Walnuts
meals.description: Tangy goat cheese on toasted bread with honey. Easy, satisfying, and kind of impressive.

ingredients.name: sliced figs or pears, fresh thyme

steps.name: Spread
steps.text: Spread 60g of soft goat cheese generously on the 2 slices of toasted sourdough.

steps.name: Top
steps.text: Drizzle with 1 tablespoon of good honey, scatter 2 tablespoons of toasted walnuts, and add fresh thyme if using.

meals.notes: Room temperature goat cheese spreads much more easily than cold. The combination of honey and goat cheese is very nearly perfect.
meals.photo_search: sourdough toast spread with goat cheese, drizzled with honey, and topped with walnuts

meals.name: Shakshuka for One
meals.description: Eggs poached in spiced tomato sauce. A dramatic, satisfying pan dinner.

steps.name: Build sauce
steps.text: Saute the half diced onion in olive oil until soft, 5 minutes. Add 2 cloves of minced garlic, 1 teaspoon of cumin, 1 teaspoon of smoked paprika, and half a teaspoon of chilli flakes, cooking 1 minute. Pour in the 1 can of diced tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes until thickened. Season generously.

steps.name: Add eggs
steps.text: Make wells in the sauce with a spoon. Crack the 2 large eggs into the wells. Cover and cook 5 to 7 minutes until whites are set but yolks runny.

steps.name: Serve
steps.text: Top with feta and parsley. Eat directly from the pan with crusty bread for dipping.

meals.notes: Serve directly from the pan. It looks dramatic and saves a dish.
meals.photo_search: cast iron skillet of shakshuka with eggs poached in spiced tomato sauce, topped with feta

meals.name: Cacio e Pepe
meals.description: Only three ingredients but requires technique. Cheese, pepper, and pasta water do everything.

steps.name: Toast pepper
steps.text: Toast 1.5 teaspoons of cracked pepper in a dry pan until fragrant. Boil 100g of pasta in salted water until 2 minutes before done, saving a cup of water.

steps.name: Make sauce
steps.text: Transfer pasta to the pepper pan over medium heat, adding pasta water gradually. Remove from heat, add 50g of pecorino and 20g of parmesan, and toss vigorously until emulsified into a silky sauce.

meals.notes: Taking the pan off heat before adding cheese prevents it from seizing. The pasta water emulsion is the entire technique.
meals.photo_search: bowl of spaghetti in a silky black pepper and pecorino sauce

meals.name: Tinned Fish Board
meals.description: The elevated pantry dinner. Sardines, smoked oysters, arranged on a board with all the accompaniments.

steps.name: Open and arrange
steps.text: Open the 1 tin of sardines and 1 tin of smoked oysters and place them directly on a board. Arrange crackers, 2 tablespoons of creme fraiche, 1 tablespoon of dijon mustard, cornichons, and capers around them. Add a lemon wedge.

meals.notes: The open tins are part of the aesthetic. Place them directly on the board. Fishwife and Ortiz are the top brands.
meals.photo_search: wooden board with open tins of sardines and oysters, crackers, cornichons, and mustard

meals.name: Avocado and Egg Salad Lettuce Cups
meals.description: Creamy mashed avocado and chopped egg in crisp lettuce. Fresh, filling, no bread needed.

steps.name: Make filling
steps.text: Combine 1 mashed ripe avocado, 2 chopped hard boiled eggs, 1 teaspoon of dijon, lemon juice, and 2 finely diced celery stalks. Season well.

steps.name: Fill cups
steps.text: Spoon the mixture into 4 to 6 crisp butter lettuce leaves and dust with paprika.

meals.notes: No mayo needed. The avocado does all the creamy work.
meals.photo_search: crisp lettuce leaves filled with creamy avocado and chopped egg salad, dusted with paprika

meals.name: Kimchi Butter Ramen
meals.description: Shin Ramyun with kimchi, butter, and a soft egg. The Korean midnight snack elevated.

ingredients.name: spring onion, sesame seeds, nori strips

steps.name: Cook noodles
steps.text: Cook the 1 packet of noodles per instructions. In the last minute, add 1/4 cup of chopped kimchi and 1 tablespoon of kimchi juice.

steps.name: Finish
steps.text: Stir in 1 tablespoon of butter until melted. Fry or poach the 1 large egg separately. Top the noodles with the egg, spring onions, and sesame seeds.

meals.notes: Aged kimchi (the sour stuff in the back of the fridge) works best. Its fermented tang cuts through the richness.
meals.photo_search: bowl of ramen with kimchi, butter, an egg, and spring onions

meals.name: Medjool Dates with Almond Butter and Flaky Salt
meals.description: Nature's candy stuffed with almond butter. The sweet salty snack that feels indulgent.

ingredients.name: dark chocolate drizzle, toasted almonds inside

steps.name: Stuff
steps.text: Slice the 4 to 5 Medjool dates lengthways and remove the pits. Fill each with a spoonful of 2 tablespoons of almond butter. Pinch closed slightly.

steps.name: Finish
steps.text: Arrange on a plate, sprinkle with flaky sea salt, and drizzle with dark chocolate if using.

meals.notes: The viral date bark trend started here. These also freeze well for a cold caramel like snack.
meals.photo_search: plate of Medjool dates stuffed with almond butter and sprinkled with flaky sea salt

meals.name: Sheet Pan Nachos
meals.description: Maximum chip to topping ratio achieved by spreading everything on one tray.

ingredients.name: sour cream, salsa, guacamole, hot sauce

steps.name: Layer
steps.text: Spread 2 large handfuls of tortilla chips in a single layer on a baking sheet. Scatter 1/4 can of drained black beans, 2 tablespoons of pickled jalapenos, and 80g of shredded cheese over every chip.

steps.name: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 400F/200C for 8 to 12 minutes until melted.

steps.name: Top and eat
steps.text: Add cold sour cream and salsa. Eat directly from the tray.

meals.notes: Eat straight from the sheet pan. It keeps them crispy and saves a dish.
meals.photo_search: sheet pan of tortilla chips loaded with melted cheese, jalapenos, and black beans

meals.name: Miso Soup with Tofu and Noodles
meals.description: Warm, savory, deeply comforting. A proper miso broth with noodles and soft tofu.

steps.name: Make broth
steps.text: Heat 2 cups of water to just below boiling. Whisk in 2 tablespoons of miso paste until dissolved. Add 1 teaspoon of soy sauce and 1 teaspoon of sesame oil.

steps.name: Add and serve
steps.text: Cook 1 portion of noodles separately and add to a bowl. Ladle the hot broth over, add 100g of cubed silken tofu, spring onions, nori, and sesame seeds.

meals.notes: Never boil miso. Add it at the very end off the heat for best flavor.
meals.photo_search: bowl of miso soup with silken tofu, noodles, spring onions, and nori

meals.name: Hot Honey Butter Toast
meals.description: The most minimal toast possible. Just good bread, real butter, and hot honey.

ingredients.name: thick white bread or brioche, toasted
hot honey (Mike's Hot Honey or homemade)

steps.name: Toast and butter
steps.text: Toast 2 slices of bread until golden. Spread 2 tablespoons of butter generously while still hot so it melts in.

steps.name: Drizzle
steps.text: Drizzle 1 tablespoon of hot honey over the buttery toast and add a pinch of flaky salt.

meals.notes: This sounds too simple to be a meal. It is not.
meals.photo_search: thick toast heavily buttered and drizzled with hot honey and flaky salt

meals.name: Loaded Sweet Potato with Black Beans
meals.description: Baked sweet potato with black beans, avocado, and lime crema. A whole satisfying meal.

steps.name: Bake potato
steps.text: Rub 1 large sweet potato with oil and salt, pierce it, and bake at 425F/220C for 45 to 50 minutes until soft.

steps.name: Load
steps.text: Split it open, fluff the inside, and top with 1/2 can of warmed black beans, half a sliced avocado, lime seasoned sour cream, and cilantro.

meals.notes: Season the inside of the potato with salt and a pat of butter before adding toppings.
meals.photo_search: baked sweet potato split open and loaded with black beans, avocado, and lime crema

meals.name: Caramelized Onion Dip with Ridged Chips
meals.description: Caramelized onion dip made from scratch. Vastly superior to the packet kind.

steps.name: Caramelize onions
steps.text: Cook 2 thinly sliced yellow onions in 2 tablespoons of butter with salt over low heat for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until deep golden and jammy. Let cool.

steps.name: Make dip
steps.text: Mix 1/2 cup of sour cream, 2 tablespoons of cream cheese, 1 teaspoon of garlic powder, and Worcestershire. Fold in the cooled onions and season.

steps.name: Serve
steps.text: Serve with ridged chips. The dip is better after an hour in the fridge.

meals.notes: You cannot rush caramelized onions. Low and slow for 30 minutes minimum.
meals.photo_search: bowl of creamy caramelized onion dip served with ridged potato chips

meals.name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
meals.description: Spaghetti with garlic, olive oil, chilli, and parsley. Italian simplicity at its finest.

ingredients.name: fresh flat leaf parsley, roughly chopped

steps.name: Cook pasta
steps.text: Boil 100g of spaghetti in well salted water until al dente, saving a cup of water.

steps.name: Toast garlic
steps.text: Warm 3 tablespoons of olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add 4 cloves of sliced garlic and cook slowly until golden. Add 1/2 teaspoon of chilli flakes.

steps.name: Combine
steps.text: Add drained pasta and a splash of pasta water. Toss vigorously until emulsified. Add a large handful of parsley and toss again.

meals.notes: Garlic must be sliced and toasted slowly to golden. Never brown or it becomes bitter.
meals.photo_search: bowl of spaghetti in garlic and olive oil with chilli flakes and fresh parsley

meals.name: Savory Cottage Cheese Bowl
meals.description: The viral protein bowl. Cottage cheese as the base for a savory, satisfying dinner.

ingredients.name: sliced avocado, pickled jalapenos, fresh herbs

steps.name: Bowl it
steps.text: Scoop 1 cup of cottage cheese into a wide bowl. Arrange half a diced cucumber and a handful of halved cherry tomatoes on top. Season with 2 tablespoons of everything bagel seasoning, drizzle with olive oil or chilli crisp.

meals.notes: Good Cultures or Kalona Supernatural cottage cheese are notably better than generic brands.
meals.photo_search: bowl of cottage cheese topped with diced cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, and everything bagel seasoning

meals.name: Panzanella
meals.description: Tuscan bread salad. Stale bread soaked in the juices of very ripe tomatoes.

ingredients.name: day old sourdough, torn into chunks

steps.name: Salt tomatoes
steps.text: Season 2 chunked tomatoes generously with salt and let sit 10 minutes. They will release juices.

steps.name: Soak bread
steps.text: Toss 2 slices of torn sourdough, 1/4 thinly sliced red onion, 2 tablespoons of olive oil, and 1 tablespoon of red wine vinegar with the tomatoes. Let sit 5 to 10 minutes so the bread absorbs the juices.

steps.name: Finish
steps.text: Add a handful of fresh basil, toss, and serve at room temperature.

meals.notes: This only works with stale bread and peak season tomatoes. Both requirements are non negotiable.
meals.photo_search: rustic bowl of panzanella salad with torn sourdough, juicy tomatoes, red onion, and basil

meals.name: Matcha Latte and Banana with Peanut Butter
meals.description: The girl dinner that is just a drink and a banana with nut butter. Deeply valid.

ingredients.name: peanut or almond butter for dipping

steps.name: Make matcha
steps.text: Sift 1 teaspoon of matcha into a mug, add 2 oz of hot water, and whisk vigorously until frothy. Pour in 6 oz of warm frothed oat milk.

steps.name: Add oat milk
steps.text: Serve with 1 banana and 2 tablespoons of peanut butter for dipping.

meals.notes: Ceremonial grade matcha is not a luxury. It is the only kind that tastes good when made simply.
meals.photo_search: mug of frothy green matcha latte served with a banana and a side of peanut butter

meals.name: White Bean Dip with Lemon and Rosemary
meals.description: Blended white beans with olive oil and lemon. A more interesting alternative to hummus.

steps.name: Blend
steps.text: Blend 1 can of drained beans, 3 tablespoons of olive oil, the juice and zest of 1 lemon, 1 sprig of rosemary, and 1 clove of garlic until completely smooth. Season well with salt.

steps.name: Serve
steps.text: Spread in a bowl, drizzle with more olive oil, and serve with crackers.

meals.notes: This also works brilliantly spread thickly on toast and topped with roasted cherry tomatoes.
meals.photo_search: bowl of creamy white bean dip with olive oil, lemon, and rosemary, served with crackers

meals.name: Egg Yolk Garlic Pasta
meals.description: Garlic pasta finished with an egg yolk. A solo carbonara for when you cannot be bothered.

steps.name: Cook pasta and garlic
steps.text: Boil 100g of pasta in salted water. Toast 3 cloves of sliced garlic in 2 tablespoons of olive oil until golden, saving pasta water.

steps.name: Combine
steps.text: Toss hot pasta with the oil and a splash of pasta water off heat. Let cool slightly, then add 1 egg yolk and toss rapidly to create a creamy sauce.

steps.name: Finish
steps.text: Add 30g of grated parmesan, toss, and season with chilli flakes and black pepper.

meals.notes: Letting the pasta cool very slightly before adding the yolk is what prevents scrambled eggs.
meals.photo_search: bowl of spaghetti in a creamy garlic sauce with grated parmesan and chilli flakes

meals.name: 4th of July Burrata Plate
meals.description: Red, white, and blue on a plate. Creamy burrata, sweet strawberries, and blueberries for a festive, no cook girl dinner.

ingredients.name: flaky sea salt and black pepper

steps.name: Arrange
steps.text: Place the burrata in the center of a plate. Arrange the halved strawberries and blueberries around it in distinct sections to emphasize the red, white, and blue colors. Tuck in fresh mint or basil leaves if using.

steps.name: Dress and Serve
steps.text: Drizzle the burrata and fruit generously with olive oil and balsamic glaze. Season with flaky sea salt and black pepper. Serve immediately with crackers or toasted baguette for scooping.

meals.notes: The ultimate 4th of July girl dinner. No cooking, just aesthetic snacking. Use fresh, in-season berries for the best flavor and sweetness.
meals.photo_search: dark moody plate with burrata, fresh strawberries, blueberries, balsamic glaze, and crackers overhead flatlay food photography

meals.name: Stracciatella with Olive Oil and Grilled Bread
meals.description: Creamy stracciatella drizzled with olive oil and black pepper. The simplest luxury.

ingredients.name: flaky sea salt and cracked black pepper
chilli oil, honey, fresh herbs, or lemon zest

steps.name: Serve
steps.text: Spoon 80g of stracciatella onto a plate. Drizzle generously with 2 tablespoons of excellent olive oil and season with flaky salt and cracked black pepper. Serve alongside toasted sourdough for scooping.

meals.notes: Stracciatella is the creamy filling from burrata. Many Italian delis sell it separately.
meals.photo_search: plate of creamy stracciatella cheese drizzled with olive oil, served with grilled bread

meals.name: Frittata for One
meals.description: Open face Italian omelette with whatever is in the fridge. Elegant and effortless.

ingredients.name: sliced cherry tomatoes, sauteed spinach, leftover potato, herbs, cheese

steps.name: Beat eggs
steps.text: Whisk 3 large eggs with 2 tablespoons of milk, 30g of grated parmesan, salt, and pepper.

steps.name: Cook
steps.text: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in an oven safe pan, add fillings, and pour in the eggs. Cook over medium heat until edges set.

steps.name: Finish under broiler
steps.text: Transfer pan to broiler for 2 to 3 minutes until golden and just set. Slice and serve from the pan.

meals.notes: Unlike an omelette, a frittata is never folded. It is finished under the broiler and sliced like a pizza.
meals.photo_search: small skillet frittata with cherry tomatoes and herbs, sliced and golden

meals.name: Labneh with Za'atar and Olive Oil
meals.description: Strained yogurt cheese with za'atar and olive oil. The Middle Eastern answer to cream cheese.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Spread 1/2 cup of labneh in a wide bowl. Drizzle with 2 tablespoons of olive oil and dust heavily with 1 tablespoon of za'atar. Serve with warm pita, radishes, and cucumber.

meals.notes: Za'atar is a blend of dried thyme, sesame seeds, sumac, and salt. Find it at any Middle Eastern grocery.
meals.photo_search: bowl of labneh drizzled with olive oil and dusted with za'atar, served with pita

meals.name: Pasta e Fagioli
meals.description: Italian peasant soup. Pasta and white beans in a rich tomato rosemary broth.

ingredients.name: parmesan rind in pot, extra olive oil, grated parmesan

steps.name: Build base
steps.text: Saute 2 cloves of minced garlic in 2 tablespoons of olive oil until golden. Add 1/2 can of crushed tomatoes, 1 cup of broth, 1 sprig of rosemary, and a parmesan rind. Simmer 10 minutes.

steps.name: Add beans and pasta
steps.text: Add half of the 1 can of beans whole and mash the rest to thicken. Add 50g of small pasta and cook until tender.

steps.name: Serve
steps.text: Ladle into a bowl, drizzle with oil, and add grated parmesan.

meals.notes: Adding a parmesan rind to the pot while it simmers adds incredible depth to the broth.
meals.photo_search: bowl of pasta e fagioli soup with white beans, small pasta, and a drizzle of olive oil

meals.name: Homemade Crunchwrap
meals.description: Flour tortilla folded around all the Taco Bell fixings. The ultimate comfort DIY.

ingredients.name: seasoned ground beef or black beans
tostada shell or large round tortilla chip

steps.name: Layer
steps.text: Spread 2 tablespoons of sour cream, 1/4 cup of beef or beans, a handful of cheese, 1 tostada, a handful of lettuce, and 2 tablespoons of salsa in the center of a large tortilla.

steps.name: Fold
steps.text: Fold the edges up in pleats all the way around. Press flat.

steps.name: Toast
steps.text: Cook in a dry pan seam side down over medium heat, pressing down, until golden and sealed.

meals.notes: The tostada in the middle is the key structural element. It gives you that crunchy layer.
meals.photo_search: golden crispy crunchwrap cut in half to show layers of beef, cheese, and lettuce

meals.name: Prosciutto and Fig Toast
meals.description: Salty cured meat and sweet figs on ricotta toast. A two minute fancy moment.

ingredients.name: fresh or dried figs, halved or sliced

steps.name: Top
steps.text: Spread 3 tablespoons of ricotta on toasted sourdough. Layer 2 slices of prosciutto and sliced figs. Drizzle with honey or balsamic glaze and season with flaky salt and pepper.

meals.notes: Fresh figs in season are extraordinary here. Out of season, good dried figs or fig jam both work.
meals.photo_search: sourdough toast spread with ricotta, topped with prosciutto, figs, and a honey drizzle

meals.name: Anchovy Butter Toast
meals.description: For the umami obsessed. Anchovies mashed into butter on very good toast.

ingredients.name: sliced radish, fresh parsley, soft boiled egg

steps.name: Make anchovy butter
steps.text: Mash 3 to 4 anchovy fillets and 2 tablespoons of butter with a fork until combined, adding a squeeze of lemon.

steps.name: Spread
steps.text: Spread generously on hot toast. Top with sliced radishes and parsley if using.

meals.notes: Anchovies in butter lose their fishiness and become pure savory depth. Anyone who thinks they do not like anchovies usually likes this.
meals.photo_search: sourdough toast spread with anchovy butter, topped with sliced radishes and lemon

meals.name: Stuffed Bell Pepper with Rice and Feta
meals.description: Two halves of roasted bell pepper filled with herby rice and feta. Easy solo dinner.

steps.name: Roast pepper
steps.text: Brush 1 halved bell pepper with 2 tablespoons of oil and roast at 400F/200C for 15 minutes to soften.

steps.name: Make filling
steps.text: Mix 1/2 cup of cooked rice, 50g of crumbled feta, a handful of tomatoes, herbs, and a drizzle of olive oil. Season well.

steps.name: Fill and finish
steps.text: Fill the peppers with rice mixture and bake another 15 to 20 minutes until golden.

meals.notes: Any leftover rice works perfectly here. Great meal to make when you have rice from the night before.
meals.photo_search: baked bell pepper halves stuffed with herby rice, feta, and cherry tomatoes

meals.name: Carbonara for One
meals.description: True carbonara. No cream, just eggs, guanciale, and pecorino. Perfect.

steps.name: Render guanciale
steps.text: Cook 50g of guanciale in a cold pan over medium heat until fat renders and edges crisp. Remove from heat.

steps.name: Make sauce
steps.text: Whisk 1 egg, 1 yolk, 30g of pecorino, and 20g of parmesan together with generous black pepper.

steps.name: Combine carefully
steps.text: Add hot pasta to the guanciale pan off heat. Add egg mixture, tossing rapidly, adding pasta water gradually until silky.

meals.notes: The pan must be off heat before adding eggs. One degree too hot and you have scrambled egg pasta.
meals.photo_search: bowl of spaghetti carbonara with crispy guanciale and a heavy dusting of black pepper

meals.name: Everything Bagel Salmon Bites
meals.description: All the vibes of a bagel and lox without the bagel. Refreshing, salty, quick.

ingredients.name: English cucumber, cut into thick rounds
capers, dill, micro greens, lemon zest

steps.name: Top
steps.text: Spread 2 tablespoons of cream cheese on thick cucumber rounds. Top with 60g of smoked salmon and dust with 1 tablespoon of everything bagel seasoning. Add capers or dill.

meals.notes: These are also great on endive spears for a slightly more elegant bite.
meals.photo_search: cucumber rounds topped with cream cheese, smoked salmon, and everything bagel seasoning

meals.name: Creamy Mushroom Toast with Thyme
meals.description: Sauteed mushrooms in garlic and thyme, splashed with cream, on thick buttered toast.

steps.name: Saute mushrooms
steps.text: Saute 200g of mushrooms in 1 tbsp butter and 1 tbsp oil without stirring until browned. Add 2 cloves of minced garlic and 2 sprigs of thyme, then 3 tablespoons of cream to reduce.

steps.name: Add aromatics and cream
steps.text: Season with salt, pepper, and a squeeze of lemon. Spoon over buttered sourdough.

meals.notes: Do not stir mushrooms immediately. Letting them brown first is what creates the deep savory flavor.
meals.photo_search: sourdough toast piled high with mushrooms in a creamy garlic thyme sauce

meals.name: Crispy Fried Rice
meals.description: Day old rice fried until crispy with soy, egg, and sesame. The solo dinner staple.

ingredients.name: frozen peas, chilli crisp, leftover protein

steps.name: Fry rice
steps.text: Press 1 cup of cold rice into a hot pan with 2 tbsp oil and let it crisp without stirring. Push aside, scramble 2 eggs, and fold through.

steps.name: Add eggs
steps.text: Add 2 tsp soy sauce, toss, and finish with 1 tsp sesame oil and 2 sliced spring onions.

meals.notes: Cold day old rice is non negotiable. Fresh rice is too wet and will steam instead of fry.
meals.photo_search: plate of crispy fried rice with scrambled egg and spring onions

meals.name: Seasonal Fruit and Cheese Plate
meals.description: Seasonal fruit with a few good cheeses. The no effort elegant dinner.

ingredients.name: seasonal fruit (grapes, sliced pear, figs, or berries)

steps.name: Arrange
steps.text: Place 1 wedge of aged cheddar and 1 wedge of brie on opposite ends of a board. Fill the gaps with seasonal fruit, nuts, and crackers. Drizzle honey over the soft cheese.

meals.notes: Let all cheeses come to room temperature for 30 minutes before eating. Cold cheese is a waste of good cheese.
meals.photo_search: wooden board with aged cheddar, brie, grapes, figs, and crackers, drizzled with honey

meals.name: 10-Minute Freezer Fried Rice
meals.description: Using entirely freezer ingredients. Frozen rice, vegetables, egg. Dinner in 10 minutes flat.

ingredients.name: frozen mixed vegetables (peas, carrots, corn, edamame)

steps.name: Fry everything
steps.text: Fry 1 pouch of rice and 1/2 cup of frozen vegetables in 1 tbsp hot oil until crispy. Push aside, scramble 2 eggs, and fold through.

steps.name: Season
steps.text: Add 2 tsp soy sauce, toss, and finish with 1 tsp sesame oil and chilli crisp.

meals.notes: Microwave pouches of rice work surprisingly well for fried rice because they are already slightly dried.
meals.photo_search: plate of fried rice with mixed vegetables, egg, and a drizzle of chilli crisp

meals.name: Pan Con Tomate
meals.description: The Catalan classic. Ripe tomato rubbed directly onto garlicky toasted bread.

steps.name: Rub
steps.text: Rub 1 halved garlic clove firmly over 2 slices of hot toast. Rub 1 halved tomato over the toast, squeezing gently to stain the bread red.

steps.name: Finish
steps.text: Drizzle with 2 tablespoons of olive oil and flaky salt.

meals.notes: The tomato must be very ripe and the bread must be hot. This is one of the great simple pleasures of eating.
meals.photo_search: toasted sourdough rubbed with tomato and garlic, drizzled with olive oil and flaky salt

meals.name: Blistered Padron Peppers
meals.description: Fried green Spanish peppers with flaky salt. Most are mild, some are brutally hot.

steps.name: Blister
steps.text: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil until smoking. Add 150g of peppers in a single layer and char on one side without stirring. Toss and cook until blistered.

steps.name: Serve
steps.text: Pile on a plate with flaky salt. Eat immediately by the stem.

meals.notes: Russian roulette included. 1 in 10 Padron peppers is genuinely spicy. That is part of the fun.
meals.photo_search: cast iron pan of blistered green padron peppers dusted heavily with flaky sea salt

meals.name: Pita Pizza
meals.description: A 10 minute pizza using pita bread as the base. Crispy, melty, endlessly customizable.

ingredients.name: sliced salami, fresh basil, olives, jarred peppers
olive oil and chilli flakes to finish

steps.name: Assemble
steps.text: Spread 3 tablespoons of sauce on 1 large pita, add 60g of cheese and toppings.

steps.name: Bake
steps.text: Bake directly on the oven rack at 425F/220C for 8 to 10 minutes until crispy.

steps.name: Finish
steps.text: Drizzle with olive oil and chilli flakes. Eat immediately.

meals.notes: Putting the pita directly on the oven rack makes the bottom incredibly crispy.
meals.photo_search: crispy pita bread pizza with melted mozzarella, tomato sauce, and basil

meals.name: Warm Olives with Orange and Herbs
meals.description: Olives gently warmed in olive oil with citrus and herbs. A 5 minute pot of wonder.

steps.name: Warm
steps.text: Combine 1 cup of olives, 3 tablespoons of olive oil, 2 strips of orange peel, 1 sprig of rosemary, 1 clove of garlic, and chilli flakes in a pan. Warm gently over low heat for 5 minutes.

steps.name: Serve
steps.text: Pour into a bowl with all the oil. Serve with crusty bread for dipping in the oil.

meals.notes: The flavored oil at the bottom is the best part. Make sure you have bread for it.
meals.photo_search: bowl of warm mixed olives in olive oil with orange peel and rosemary, served with bread

meals.name: Creamy Tuscan White Beans
meals.description: Butter beans simmered in garlic, tomatoes, and spinach. Italian pantry perfection.

steps.name: Build
steps.text: Saute 3 cloves of sliced garlic in 2 tablespoons of oil, add a handful of tomatoes until they burst. Add 1 can of beans and a splash of wine, simmering and mashing some beans to thicken.

steps.name: Add beans
steps.text: Stir in a handful of spinach until wilted. Season. Drizzle with more oil. Serve with bread and parmesan.

meals.notes: Lightly mashing some of the beans is what makes the sauce creamy without adding any cream.
meals.photo_search: skillet of creamy Tuscan white beans with tomatoes, spinach, and garlic, served with bread

meals.name: Silky Egg Drop Soup
meals.description: Better than takeout. Silky egg ribbons in a gingery, savory broth.

ingredients.name: spring onion, white pepper, sesame seeds

steps.name: Build broth
steps.text: Simmer 1.5 cups of broth with 1 tsp ginger, 1 tsp soy, and 1 tsp sesame oil. Add 1 tsp cornstarch mixture to thicken.

steps.name: Add eggs
steps.text: Slowly pour 2 beaten eggs in a thin stream while stirring gently to form ribbons.

steps.name: Serve
steps.text: Top with spring onions, white pepper, and sesame seeds.

meals.notes: Pour the eggs in very slowly and stir very gently. Fast movement creates bits rather than ribbons.
meals.photo_search: bowl of silky egg drop soup with spring onions and sesame seeds

meals.name: Roasted Tomato and Burrata Toast
meals.description: Slow roasted sweet tomatoes with creamy burrata on grilled bread. The best toast.

ingredients.name: flaky salt, black pepper, balsamic glaze

steps.name: Roast tomatoes
steps.text: Toss 200g of tomatoes with 3 tablespoons of oil, 1 clove of minced garlic, salt, and pepper. Roast at 400F/200C for 25 minutes until jammy.

steps.name: Assemble
steps.text: Top 2 slices of grilled bread with 1 torn ball of burrata. Spoon warm roasted tomatoes and all their juices over the top. Add basil, balsamic, and salt.

meals.notes: The tomato juices and olive oil are the sauce. Make sure you get all of it out of the roasting pan.
meals.photo_search: grilled sourdough topped with torn burrata, roasted tomatoes, basil, and balsamic glaze

meals.name: Spicy Tuna Crispy Rice
meals.description: Sushi grade tuna, sesame spiced and piled onto shatteringly crispy pan fried rice cakes.

ingredients.name: spring onion, sesame seeds, avocado, jalapeno

steps.name: Season tuna
steps.text: Mix 150g of diced tuna with 1 tbsp soy, 1 tbsp sriracha mayo, and 1 tsp sesame oil. Toss gently and refrigerate.

steps.name: Form rice cakes
steps.text: Press 1 cup of cold rice flat and cut into rectangles with a wet knife.

steps.name: Fry
steps.text: Fry rice cakes in oil until golden and crispy. Drain on paper towel.

steps.name: Top
steps.text: Spoon tuna onto each rice cake. Garnish with spring onion, sesame, avocado, and jalapeno.

meals.notes: The rice must be cold and slightly dried. Day old fridge rice works best.
meals.photo_search: crispy fried rice cakes topped with spicy diced tuna, avocado, and jalapeno

meals.name: Takis with Chamoy and Lime
meals.description: Hot chips drizzled with chamoy and lime. The chaotic snack dinner that TikTok loves.

ingredients.name: Takis Fuego or Flamin Hot Cheetos

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Pour 1 bag of chips into a bowl. Drizzle with 2 tablespoons of chamoy, squeeze 1 lime over, and dust with Tajin. Add fresh fruit and vegetables on the side if using.

meals.notes: Adding fruit alongside the chips makes it a significantly more balanced and interesting meal. Mango and cucumber are ideal.
meals.photo_search: plate of Takis chips drizzled with chamoy, lime juice, and Tajin seasoning

meals.name: Overnight Oats as Dinner
meals.description: The reverse breakfast dinner. Prepared oats with toppings eaten at any hour.

ingredients.name: berries, banana, granola, nut butter, coconut flakes

steps.name: Mix
steps.text: Combine 1/2 cup of oats, 1/2 cup of milk, 1/4 cup of yogurt, 1 tbsp chia seeds, and 1 tbsp sweetener in a jar. Stir well, cover, and refrigerate overnight.

steps.name: Top
steps.text: When ready to eat, add toppings. Thin with a splash of milk if needed.

meals.notes: Works as a make ahead dinner too. Prep in the afternoon and eat in the evening.
meals.photo_search: jar of overnight oats topped with berries, chia seeds, and a drizzle of nut butter

meals.name: Creamed Spinach on Toast
meals.description: Classic steakhouse creamed spinach reduced down to a solo toast topping. Rich and ridiculous.

steps.name: Wilt spinach
steps.text: Wilt 200g of spinach in 2 tbsp butter with 1 clove of minced garlic. Add 3 tbsp cream, 30g parmesan, and a pinch of nutmeg until thickened.

steps.name: Cream
steps.text: Pile onto 2 slices of buttered sourdough toast.

meals.notes: Squeeze out excess liquid from the wilted spinach before adding cream to prevent a watery sauce.
meals.photo_search: sourdough toast topped with rich creamed spinach and parmesan

meals.name: Mango with Tajin and Lime
meals.description: Sweet ripe mango sliced and dusted with Tajin and lime. The refreshing solo dessert dinner.

ingredients.name: chamoy drizzle, chilli flakes, fresh mint

steps.name: Slice
steps.text: Cut 1 large mango flesh into slices or cubes.

steps.name: Season
steps.text: Arrange on a plate. Squeeze half a lime over, dust generously with 1 tsp Tajin. Drizzle with chamoy if using.

meals.notes: The mango must be ripe. Under ripe mango with chilli is just confusing.
meals.photo_search: plate of fresh mango slices dusted with Tajin and lime juice

meals.name: Solo Charcuterie Board with Wine
meals.description: A proper small board built for one, with wine. This is aspirational solo dining.

steps.name: Build the board
steps.text: Place 40g of manchego and 40g of brie at opposite corners of a board. Fold 30g of prosciutto and 30g of salami and fill gaps with olives, fruit, and 1 tbsp of nuts. Add crackers and pour a glass of wine.

steps.name: Eat slowly
steps.text: Graze. This is a meal. Take your time.

meals.notes: Never rush a board. The whole point is that you eat slowly and enjoy it.
meals.photo_search: small wooden board with prosciutto, manchego, brie, olives, grapes, and a glass of wine

meals.name: Honey Garlic Butter Shrimp
meals.description: Shrimp cooked in 5 minutes in a sticky honey garlic butter. Eat with bread or rice.

ingredients.name: raw shrimp or prawns, peeled and deveined

steps.name: Season shrimp
steps.text: Pat 150g of shrimp dry and season with salt and pepper.

steps.name: Cook
steps.text: Sear in 2 tbsp butter with 3 cloves of minced garlic. Add 1 tbsp honey and 1 tbsp soy sauce, tossing until glazed. Squeeze lemon over and serve with bread.

meals.notes: Patting shrimp completely dry before cooking is what lets them sear rather than steam.
meals.photo_search: skillet of shrimp in a sticky honey garlic butter sauce with lemon

meals.name: Smoked Oyster Toast
meals.description: A tin of smoked oysters on buttered rye toast with hot sauce. Deeply underrated girl dinner.

ingredients.name: hot sauce, lemon juice, cracked pepper

steps.name: Toast and butter
steps.text: Toast 2 slices of bread until deeply golden. Butter generously with 2 tbsp of butter.

steps.name: Top
steps.text: Lay 1 tin of smoked oysters on toast. Add hot sauce, a squeeze of lemon, and black pepper. Add cream cheese and shallot if using.

meals.notes: Crown Prince or Rugen Fisch are reliable smoked oyster brands. Serve with wine for the full experience.
meals.photo_search: rye toast heavily buttered and topped with smoked oysters, hot sauce, and lemon

meals.name: Roasted Beet and Goat Cheese Salad
meals.description: Earthy roasted beets, tangy goat cheese, and candied walnuts. Classic bistro salad.

ingredients.name: pre cooked beets (vacuum packed, not pickled), sliced

steps.name: Make dressing
steps.text: Whisk together 1 tbsp balsamic, 2 tbsp olive oil, and 1 tsp dijon. Season.

steps.name: Assemble
steps.text: Dress 2 handfuls of arugula lightly and arrange with 1 pack of sliced beets, 2 tbsp of crumbled goat cheese, and a handful of candied walnuts.

meals.notes: Pre roasted vacuum packed beets are a completely valid shortcut and nearly as good as roasting your own.
meals.photo_search: plate of arugula, sliced roasted beets, crumbled goat cheese, and candied walnuts

meals.name: Tteokbokki
meals.description: Korean rice cakes in spicy sweet gochujang sauce. The ultimate comfort street food.

ingredients.name: cylindrical rice cakes (tteok), fresh or frozen
fish cake slices, boiled egg, spring onion, sesame seeds

steps.name: Make sauce
steps.text: Combine 2 tbsp gochujang, 1 tbsp soy, and 1 tbsp sugar in a pan with 1 cup of water. Stir over medium heat until combined.

steps.name: Cook rice cakes
steps.text: Add 200g of rice cakes and simmer 8 to 10 minutes until soft and the sauce reduces to a thick glaze.

steps.name: Serve
steps.text: Plate and top with spring onions and sesame seeds.

meals.notes: Soak frozen rice cakes in cold water for 20 minutes before cooking to soften them.
meals.photo_search: bowl of tteokbokki rice cakes in a thick red gochujang sauce with spring onions

meals.name: Tahini and Honey Toast
meals.description: Nutty tahini with honey and sesame seeds. A two ingredient toast that is weirdly addictive.

steps.name: Toast
steps.text: Toast 2 slices of bread to a deep golden color.

steps.name: Top
steps.text: Spread 2 tbsp of tahini generously while bread is hot. Drizzle 1 tbsp honey over the top. Finish with a pinch of flaky salt and sesame seeds.

meals.notes: Good tahini is essential. It should be pourable and smell nutty. If it tastes bitter it is a bad batch.
meals.photo_search: toasted bread spread with tahini, drizzled with honey, and sprinkled with sesame seeds

meals.name: Store-Bought Pork Belly Bao
meals.description: Using supermarket char siu pork belly and frozen steamed buns. Restaurant at home.

ingredients.name: store bought char siu or roast pork belly, sliced

steps.name: Steam buns
steps.text: Steam 2 to 3 frozen bao buns until fluffy.

steps.name: Warm pork
steps.text: Warm 100g of pork belly slices in a hot pan until edges caramelize.

steps.name: Build
steps.text: Open bao, spread 2 tbsp hoisin inside, add pork, pickled vegetables, cilantro, and 1 tsp sriracha.

meals.notes: Frozen bao buns are available at most Asian supermarkets and steam back to perfect in minutes.
meals.photo_search: fluffy steamed bao buns filled with pork belly, hoisin sauce, and cucumber

meals.name: Olive Oil Cake with Macerated Berries
meals.description: A slice of Italian olive oil cake with macerated berries as dinner. Acceptable and right.

ingredients.name: olive oil cake, bakery or homemade
whipped cream, mascarpone, or vanilla yogurt

steps.name: Macerate berries
steps.text: Toss 1 cup of berries with 1 tsp sugar and 1 tsp lemon juice for 10 minutes until they release their juice.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Serve 1 slice of cake alongside or topped with macerated berries and cream if using.

meals.notes: Olive oil cake from a good Italian bakery is one of the great things. If you cannot find it, it is also very easy to make.
meals.photo_search: plate with a slice of olive oil cake topped with juicy macerated berries

meals.name: Butter Lettuce with Champagne Vinaigrette
meals.description: The lightest, most elegant salad. Butter lettuce with a bright, acidic champagne dressing.

ingredients.name: shaved parmesan, toasted hazelnuts, sliced radish

steps.name: Make vinaigrette
steps.text: Whisk 1 tbsp vinegar, 1 tsp dijon, and 1 clove of minced garlic together. Slowly stream in 3 tbsp olive oil until emulsified. Season with salt and white pepper.

steps.name: Dress and serve
steps.text: Gently toss 1 head of butter lettuce leaves with just enough dressing to coat lightly. Plate immediately and add parmesan or hazelnuts.

meals.notes: Underdress rather than overdress. Butter lettuce wilts quickly. Add dressing at the very last second before serving.
meals.photo_search: elegant bowl of butter lettuce lightly coated in champagne vinaigrette with shaved parmesan
